title: The Battles Against the Philistines and the Descendants of the Giants
description: A series of battles between David and the Philistines, in which four descendants of the giants from Gath were struck down. David himself became exhausted in battle and was nearly killed by Ishbi-Benob, but Abishai rescued him, and David's men swore that he should not go out to war again, so as not to extinguish the lamp of Israel. Sibbecai killed Saph at Gob, Elhanan struck down the Gittite Goliath with a spear shaft like a weaver's beam, and Jonathan, the son of David's brother, felled a giant who had six fingers on each hand and six toes on each foot.
